title: převod opus → MP3 v parametrech, které ČSOB přijímá
interface: final class Drupal\csobrec\Service\Mp3Converter. Constructor (\Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, ?\Closure $runner = NULL). The binary is csobrec.settings:ffmpeg, falling back to 'ffmpeg' when the setting is NULL or empty. $runner is for tests: \Closure(list<string> $command): array{0: int, 1: string} returning [exit code, stderr]; when it is NULL the service runs the command with \Symfony\Component\Process\Process (no shell, so no quoting worries) and reads getExitCode()/getErrorOutput() — give the process no timeout or a generous one, a long recording takes a while. command(string $source, string $target): array returns exactly [<binary>, '-y', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', $source, '-codec:a', 'libmp3lame', '-ar', '8000', '-ac', '2', '-b:a', '32k', $target]. These are not preferences: they were measured with ffprobe on a recording ČSOB already accepts (mp3, 8000 Hz, 2 channels, 32 kb/s). convert(string $source, string $target): string checks the source is an existing file FIRST and throws \RuntimeException naming it without running anything; then runs command() once; a non-zero exit is \RuntimeException carrying the code and ffmpeg's stderr; on success returns $target.
